lavo-park-highway.segment: The 30-mile park highway (State Route 89) through Lassen Volcanic NP between the Southwest Entrance (Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center) and the Northwest Entrance (Manzanita Lake / Loomis Plaza). Open = the day the whole highway opened to through vehicle traffic; close = the day it closed to through traffic for the winter (per the NPS table).
years: 疫情封园，5 月 29 日随分阶段开放才通车

sources.covers: All years 1980-2026: NPS table 'Road Opening and Closing Dates, 1980 to Present' (date plowing began, date road opened, April 1 snow depth at Lake Helen, date road closed). Page last updated May 24, 2026; 2026 closing still blank. Every date in 'years' comes from this table.
2006 opening July 6 (matches table)
2006: rotary snowplow and grader vandalized Apr 20-21, 2006, delaying spring plowing by days
2006 closing announced Nov 14 (table: Nov 11; a storm had closed the road temporarily from Nov 2)
2007 opening May 18 (matches table); says earliest opening ever was Apr 28, 1990
2007 closing announced Dec 7 (table: Dec 6)

romo-trail-ridge-road.segment: Through travel on Trail Ridge Road between Many Parks Curve (east side) and the Colorado River Trailhead (west side), over the 12,183 ft high point and Alpine Visitor Center. Open = day it opened to through travel for the season; close = NPS official 'closed for the season to through travel' day.
years: 疫情封园到 5 月 27 日，6 月 4 日才通车；秋天 East Troublesome 山火从 10 月 21 日起封路

sources.covers: Official RMNP table 'Trail Ridge Road and Old Fall River Road Opening and Closing Dates' (compiled from Superintendent's Annual Reports, Roads Office data and the PIO): official opening and official closing 1932-2008, plus the date after which the road was not reopened (in parentheses) for many years; 2009 opening May 21. Source of all 1980-2008 dates.
2002 opening May 7 (earliest ever) and 2001 opening May 25 (matches table)
2006 official closing Oct 23 (matches table)
2007 opening May 25; says 2006 opened May 20 (table: May 24) and 2006 closed Oct 23; 2007 repair project with delays/night closures
2008 opening May 23; 2007 closing Oct 22
2008 closing Nov 6; list of official closings 1999-2007 (matches table)

romo-old-fall-river-road.segment: The 9.4-mile one-way (uphill) gravel road from Endovalley Picnic Area to Fall River Pass / Alpine Visitor Center, where it joins Trail Ridge Road. Open/close = the vehicle season.
years: 2013 年 9 月洪水冲毁，整年没开，2015 年 7 月 2 日才修好重开

sources.covers: Official RMNP table: Old Fall River Road official opening and closing 1985-2008 (1984 opening '?', 1985 closing 'Sept. 8 or Oct. 11'), 2009 closing Oct 8; parentheses = not reopened after that date (2003: Oct 31, 2004: Sept 30). NPS: no good long-term records before 1985; road closed 1950-1960.
2006 closing Sept 26 (matches table)
2008 closing Oct 20 (matches table)
2009 closing Oct 8 (matches table); 2009 opening not found
2010 closing Oct 13; 2010 opening not found
2011: not expected to open by July 4 (heavy snowpack)

mora-sunrise-road.segment: Sunrise Road from the White River Campground junction up to Sunrise (6,400 ft). The lower White River Road from SR 410 to the campground junction opens weeks earlier and closes later; these dates are for driving all the way to Sunrise.
years: Grand Park 2 山火，8 月 7 日起对车辆封闭到年底，只能步行、骑车上去
